foreword.text: This Standard Operating Procedure explains, step by step, how to install, configure and use the JSS Publisher software to author and publish S1000D and JSS technical publications. Every care has been taken in the preparation of this document and its technical content has been verified against the software it describes. However, the reader is requested to communicate by E-mail/ Letter/ Telephone/ Fax to Larsen & Toubro, if any error is observed or there are any suggestions to improve this document.

safetyWarning.text: at a time, on one machine

cautionsNotes: Run only one instance of the server (npm start) at a time; a second instance's file watcher can overwrite a project's generated PDF mid-build.
Save (or Save & Generate) in the Settings drawer before closing the browser tab; edits made there are not written to disk until saved.
Back up the workspace/ folder regularly. It holds every project's source files, house templates and the SQLite project registry.
Do not edit files inside client-dist/ directly. That folder is rebuilt automatically from client/ and any direct changes are lost on the next build.
Install Java (JRE 11 or later) and confirm it is on the PATH before starting the server, otherwise PDF generation falls back to the slower fop.bat path.
Uploads always target the currently active project. Confirm the correct project is open before uploading a PMC, a data module, or Media.
Use Quick Preview to iterate quickly on a single data module. Always run a full Generate before final review, since Quick Preview omits front matter.
